text_blocks.snippet: The cost of a US student visa typically includes two main fees: the SEVIS fee (I-901) and the nonimmigrant visa application fee (also known as the MRV fee). The SEVIS fee is currently $350 for F and M visas. The nonimmigrant visa application fee is $185 for student visas. Therefore, the total cost for a US student visa application can be around $535.
